title: ヒシアマ姐さんの特等席

text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon and I are on our way home after a day out, when…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey Teach, you free after this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If you're up for it, there's somethin' I wanna show you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh. I think it's better if it's left a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Look, you can see the whole town from up here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There isn't anything special about this hill right now, but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh good, looks like we've come just in time.
From up on the hill, we watch the town get bathed in red as the sun slowly sets.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Pretty great view, eh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I found this place by chance back when I was in the middle of some hill training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I was exhausted after clearing this hill in one huge sprint, but I totally forgot how tired I was the second I laid eyes on the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I thought it'd be nice if you could see it too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I always thought of sunsets the way they show 'em in gangster flicks—lookin' up at the sky from the riverside after a good one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But they hit different when you look down at them from up here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, wanna see what'll happen next?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, let's just take a rest on that bench for a bit and find out.
The sun is about to completely set, but I sit on the bench as instructed.
Eventually, the sky turns dark, and the town below us twinkles to life with sparks of light.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whaddya think? Pretty cool that we can see the nighttime scenery like this so close to the academy, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The air is pretty fresh round here despite this being an urban area, and there's nothin' blocking the stars.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I owe you a lot, Teach. This is my thanks for everything you do.
choice_data_list: Thank you. It's so like you to bring me here as thanks.

I didn't take you for the sentimental type.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I owe you a lot, Teach. This is my thanks for everything you do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Well, I've always been the type to aim for the top, both literally and figuratively.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've always liked goin' to the very top of high places. It gets me feelin' refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I used to compete with my friends to see who could climb up trees and boulders the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I might not look the part, but I was raised in a rural part of the U.S.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: One time, I got myself into an accident. Jumped off a big rock at a campsite, and came down covered in scrapes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The night sky I saw back then was beautiful, but… this one might be just as good.
I enjoy the night view with Hishi Amazon as she tells me all about her wild childhood.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What do you take me for? Some kinda mushy poser?!
choice_data_list: Well, I thought it was pretty cute of you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Shut up, you dummy! Who're you callin' "cute"?! Don't go actin' like Fuji now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm the Hishi Amazon—the all-powerful, awe-inspiring head of Miho Dorm!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Geez! I can't believe you of all people are making fun of me!
She's adorable when she's mad too, but I keep that to myself. I don't actually want to upset her.
